title: Find the French foreign names of cards that are legal in the Legacy format,
question: Find the French foreign names of cards that are legal in the Legacy format, have unknown power (NULL or '*'), and were illustrated by an artist who has illustrated fewer than 5 cards in total.

prediction.sql: SELECT T3."XCL_079" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_082" WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'legacy' AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal' AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*') AND T3."XCL_077" = 'French' AND T1."XCL_002" IN (SELECT "XCL_002" FROM cards WHERE "XCL_002" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "XCL_002" HAVING COUNT(*) < 5)
